title: Yellow Spicy Peruvian Vegetable Stir Fry
description: A spicy and chewy Peruvian dish featuring chopped parsley and infused oil, perfect for a crowd, this vegan-friendly stir fry is made in a wok and is sure to please. It combines the flavors of Peru with the convenience of a stir fry.
instructions: Heat the infused oil in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until it starts to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook until it starts to soften.
Add the sliced zucchini and cook until it starts to soften.
Add the diced yellow potatoes and cook until they are tender, stirring occasionally.
Add the chopped parsley, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the top of the stir fry and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the stir fry hot, garnished with additional chopped parsley if desired.
